data.long_meaning: The name Arbas is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arbhu' which means 'mountain'. This name is associated with strength, courage, and vitality. It is a powerful name that evokes the image of a mighty mountain, unyielding and steadfast. The name Arbas carries the meaning “Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Arbas usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arbas is a name that embodies the spiritual power of the earth and the strength of the mountains. It is a name that inspires one to be strong, courageous, and vital, to overcome challenges and obstacles, and to find inner peace and balance.
data.etymology: Arbas belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arbas total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
